analysis:
Examined quickstart head text and changed ranges, configuration metadata/patch, and supplied base configuration context. docs/provider/quickstart.md:65-71,109,113-116 now describe automatic catalog downloads and expansion of the consented Autopilot set rather than a static inventory. docs/reference/configuration.md patch head:180-186 documents cross-window retention conditional on unchanged hashes, default-enabled downloads with saved consent, optional storage/model caps, a 50 GiB free-space reserve, and an owner-only bounded download ledger. No executable implementation is supplied, so these documented contracts do not independently establish a missing control or security regression. Surrounding authorization, logout, encryption, cache-scope and billing text does not show a changed control.
Integration should examine AutopilotDownloadSettings.swift, AutopilotDownload.swift, AutopilotDownloadLedger.swift, ProviderLoop+AutopilotModelSet.swift and ScheduledWindowSelection.swift: verify consent and rollout gating, catalog/hash qualification before advertisement or loading, offline ledger trust, config-refresh disabling, and budget accounting across downloads and scheduled windows. These affect A-004, T-012/T-027 and T-016; automatic disk growth also interacts with T-041's SSD-cache budget/free-space guards on a shared volume. Determine whether the canonical model needs an explicit automatic-download/storage boundary after inspecting runtime evidence. The ledger's model hashes are not prompt-prefix hashes; its documentation alone does not establish a T-041 disclosure. Missing runtime source leaves material integrity and availability contracts unresolved, not proven unsafe or safe.
